items.title: Susan Dell's 'frozen' Oval Office face sets off Mar-a-Lago face jokes
items.summary: Philanthropist Susan Dell stood beside President Trump in the Oval Office to promote the Dells' $6.25 billion pledge to Trump Accounts, but viewers fixated on her still expressions and makeup instead. Clips spread across X with 'NPC', 'robot' and 'reptilian' comparisons and jokes like 'someone at the White House needs to hit CTRL + ALT + DELETE.' The moment revived the 'Mar-a-Lago face' meme, while others pushed back on mocking her appearance.
items.author: @iluminatibot

items.title: Marlins Man chats up Dua Lipa at her first baseball game
items.summary: At Game 3 of the Yankees-Rays ALDS, broadcast cameras caught Marlins Man, the famous fan in the orange jersey, chatting all night with Dua Lipa and her husband Callum Turner behind home plate. X users joked he was shooting his shot, not realizing her husband was right there. He later posted that he had no idea who they were, and that it was her first game and her first hot dog.
items.author: @marlins_man

post.name: Marlins_Man
post.text: So i had no idea who this couple were and they were so nice and friendly to everyone.  I told them i know sports, not music nor movies.  They recently got married in june in italy i think.  I wish them 50 years or more of happiness.
